items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And we liked Jesse because Jesse would throw anything on the paper... Jesse Hickenbotham and Georgie and another horn... would come out and just step right up on the stage and play background... Eddie Durham wrote the show

ctx.x: And we liked Jesse because Jesse would throw anything on the paper and we liked that.
Yeah, I was going to say, he was -- as an arranger, he was ahead in those days, wasn't he?
